modelValue.zh-CN: 当前值，配合 v-model 使用；传入后由该值决定显示，变回 undefined 时回到 defaultValue 并转为非受控。
modelValue.en-US: Current value, used with v-model. When given, this value decides what is shown; back to undefined it returns to defaultValue and becomes uncontrolled.

allowHalf.en-US: Whether half stars can be selected.

allowClear.zh-CN: 是否允许再次点击后清除。
allowClear.en-US: Whether clicking the selected star again clears the value.

disabled.zh-CN: 只读，无法进行交互，也无法获得焦点。
disabled.en-US: Read-only: no interaction and no focus.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 default、small，也可传入 number 自定义尺寸。
size.en-US: Size: default or small, or a number for a custom size.

prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the component.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 指示浏览器是否应滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的聚焦。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser should avoid scrolling the document to show the newly focused element, for focus inside the component.

ariaLabel.zh-CN: radiogroup 的可访问名称；缺省时名称概括当前取值。
ariaLabel.en-US: Accessible name of the radiogroup; without it the name summarizes the value.

update:modelValue.zh-CN: 选择变化时触发，供 v-model 回写。
update:modelValue.en-US: Emitted when the selection changes, for v-model to write back.

change.zh-CN: 选择变化时触发，参数为新的值。
change.en-US: Emitted when the selection changes, with the new value.

hoverChange.zh-CN: 指针经过时数值变化；指针移出或点击清除时收到 undefined。
hoverChange.en-US: Emitted when the hovered value changes; receives undefined when the pointer leaves or a click clears the value.

click.zh-CN: 点击星或按 Enter、Space 选中时触发，参数为事件与星的序号；会遮住根元素上的原生 click 监听。
click.en-US: Emitted when a star is clicked or selected with Enter or Space, with the event and the star index. It shadows a native click listener on the root element.

focus.zh-CN: 焦点进入整个评分组件时触发，在星之间移动不触发。
focus.en-US: Emitted when focus enters the rating; moving between stars does not emit it.

blur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个评分组件时触发。
blur.en-US: Emitted when focus leaves the rating.

keydown.zh-CN: 仅在方向键使值移动时触发。
keydown.en-US: Emitted only for an arrow key that moved the value.

character.zh-CN: 每颗星中绘制的字符；只含文本时，该文本作为各星可访问名称与整组摘要的单位，否则用语言包的单位。
character.en-US: Character drawn in every star. When it is plain text, that text is the unit in each star's accessible name and the group summary; otherwise the locale's unit is used.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦 Tab 会到达的 radio，与 autofocus 的落点相同；disabled 时无效果。
focus.en-US: Focuses the radio that Tab reaches, the same one autofocus uses. Does nothing when disabled.

blur.zh-CN: 让评分内获得焦点的元素失焦；焦点不在评分内或 disabled 时无效果。
blur.en-US: Blurs the focused element inside the rating. Does nothing when focus is elsewhere or the rating is disabled.
